About this site

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

library(fivethirtyeight)

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings

candy <- candy |>
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ "both",
    chocolate ~ "chocolate",
    fruity ~ "fruity",
    .default = "other"
  ))

##count(candy, type)
```

## Row 1

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "warning",
  value = nrow(candy))

```

```{r}
#| context: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Fruity Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "warning",
  value = sum(candy$type == "fruity"))

```
